map.热处理硬度/温度曲线 使用指南: Heat Treatment Hardness/Temperature Curve User Guide
map.选择钢种与热处理工艺（如回火），根据经验关系估算处理后钢材的硬度值（HRC），为: Choose a steel grade and heat treatment process (such as tempering) and estimate the resulting hardness (HRC) from empirical relations, supporting process planning and quality prediction.
map.根据钢种与热处理工艺估算回火后硬度（HRC）: Estimate the post-tempering hardness (HRC) from the steel grade and heat treatment process
map.按截面尺寸与临界淬透直径判断心部是否淬透。: Judge whether the core is hardened from the section size and the critical hardenability diameter.
map.比较不同钢种的淬硬层深度。: Compare the case depth of different steel grades.
map.大截面件改选高淬透性钢种。: Use a steel grade with better hardenability for large sections.
map.：某钢临界淬透直径 D0=30 mm（油淬）。截面 50 mm > 30 mm：: : a steel with critical hardenability diameter D0 = 30 mm (oil quench) and a 50 mm section > 30 mm means the core cannot be fully hardened and is much softer than the surface (say 55 HRC at the surface versus 35 HRC in the core); a steel with a larger D0 or water quenching is needed.
map.：表硬随距表面增大而降，有效淬硬层深按 HRC 降 50% 处界定。: : surface hardness falls with distance from the surface, and the effective case depth is defined where HRC drops by 50%.
map.淬透性=能淬透的截面大小（合金元素影响）；淬硬性=能达到的最高硬度（碳含量决定）: Hardenability is the section size that can be hardened through (driven by alloying elements); hardness is the maximum hardness achievable (determined by carbon content). They are different.
map.截面超限怎么办？: What if the Section Exceeds the Limit?
map.选更高淬透性钢、提高冷却烈度（水淬/淬火液）或改表面淬火（感应/渗碳）只硬表层。: Choose steel with higher hardenability, increase cooling severity (water quench or polymer), or switch to surface hardening (induction or carburizing) to harden only the outer layer.
